method: CPU-only; load the pinned NIfTI member from its exact archive, independently verify compressed member CRC plus uncompressed SHA-256, process each label inside its intake-v4 voxel bounding box plus one-voxel margin, emit binary-little-endian PLY in this scan affine RAS millimetres, gzip deterministically.

predictions_before_source_run.topology: Report edge incidence, vertex-link manifold count, and closed-two-manifold result as observed; no topology repair, smoothing, or decimation.

purpose: Test whether exact voxel-union boundary candidates can be built from the pinned registered source labels with independent occupancy and affine-volume closure.
stopping_and_exclusion_rules: One frozen run only. Do not change source, scan, labels, affine, threshold, or mesh method after inspecting output.
Any identity, count, or occupancy-volume gate failure is a failed source-bound run and must remain documented.

Topology metrics are descriptive; do not promote source segmentation or mesh to expert anatomical accuracy, cross-scan registration, Numi subject binding, material admission, mechanics, physiology, or clinical evidence.
